title: Mutual Aid Map Coverage Gaps
dataSources: Volunteer shifts (`community:shift`), donations (`community:donation`), mutual-aid requests (`community:mutualaid`), service ops (`community:impact`).
app: Community-service telemetry — food-bank shift logs, blood-donation records, and mutual-aid request maps — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=community:mutualaid region=* coverage_state=*
| stats sum(eval(if(coverage_state!="covered",1,0))) as backlog, count as total by region
| where backlog>0
| sort - backlog
description: Lists pending coverage gaps backlog by region for mutual-aid mapping.
value: Backlog counts expose where small unfinished tasks accumulate and create hidden drag inside mutual-aid mapping.
implementation: Mark each `community:mutualaid` record with a pending-state flag and summarize backlog totals by `region`.
visualization: Table of region with pending coverage gaps counts.
grandmaExplanation: It turns where unfinished coverage gaps are piling up so you can clear the biggest queues in mutual-aid mapping.
